concerns.text: Task T003 (epoching) is placed before Task T004 (ICA blink‑component detection & removal). ICA should be applied to the continuous/subsampled data *before* epoching so that artifact‑free epochs are produced. The current order makes the epoching step consume un‑cleaned data, violating the intended producer‑before‑consumer data flow.

The verification clause for T004 states “ICA variance reduction ≥ 10 % on frontal channels (checked by task T011)”. Task T011 (visualization) occurs much later in the pipeline, so the verification step depends on a future task, creating a consumer‑before‑producer dependency.

Nearly every task is tagged `[P]` (parallel‑safe) yet many write to shared directories/files (e.g., `data/raw/`, `data/processed/`, `results/`, log files). Running these in parallel would cause race conditions and nondeterministic outputs, so the `[P]` annotation is unsafe for tasks such as T001, T002, T004, T005, T006, T007, T008, T009, T010, T011, T012, and T013.
